methodologyNotes: Covers interchangeable-lens-camera photographic lenses (mirrorless and DSLR) currently sold at a published US MSRP. Includes first-party and third-party autofocus and manual-focus lenses for full-frame, APS-C, Micro Four Thirds, and medium-format mounts. Excludes fixed-lens cameras, cine/PL-cinema lenses, smartphone add-on lenses, teleconverters, and enlarger/projection optics. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. focalLengthMm is the focal length in millimeters, a single number for primes or a low-high range string for zooms (e.g. '24-70'); on APS-C/MFT lenses this is the native focal length, not full-frame equivalent. maxApertureF is the maximum (fastest) aperture as an f-number, lower is brighter; for variable-aperture zooms it is the wide-to-tele range string (e.g. '3.5-5.6'). lensMount is the native mount enum (e.g. 'Sony E', 'Canon RF', 'Nikon Z', 'L-Mount', 'Canon EF', 'Fujifilm X', 'Micro Four Thirds', 'Fujifilm G'). formatCoverage is the largest sensor the image circle covers, enum: 'full-frame', 'APS-C', 'Micro Four Thirds', or 'medium-format'. opticalStabilization is a boolean, true if the lens has built-in optical image stabilization (OSS/IS/VR/OIS/VC), false if it relies only on in-body stabilization. minFocusDistanceM is the closest focusing distance in meters, measured from the sensor plane. maxMagnification is the maximum reproduction ratio as a decimal (e.g. 1.0 for life-size 1:1, 0.5 for 1:2). filterThreadMm is the front screw-in filter thread diameter in millimeters; null if the lens takes no front filter (e.g. bulb front element or rear-only filters). apertureBlades is the integer count of diaphragm blades. weatherSealed is a boolean, true if the manufacturer specifies dust/moisture sealing. weightGrams is the lens weight in grams without caps or hood.
